name: Bank of Kaohsiung Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Kaohsiung Co., Ltd. provides various banking products and services in Taiwan, America, Australia, the United Arab Emirates, the Cayman Islands, the Viking Islands, and internationally. The company offers checking accounts, public treasury deposits, demand deposits, fixed deposits, demand savings deposits, and fixed savings deposits; remittances; and negotiable certificates of deposits. It is also involved in the domestic deposit and loan business; investment and trading in securities; overseas deposit business; and public treasury, trust, and insurance agency businesses.
